title: JtA synthetic game dataset
description: Versioned dataset carrying ALL Journey to Ascension content (skills, zones/tasks, perks, items, prestige, roles, economy, theme) — the spine of the synthetic-data feature (CC/docs/plans/jta-synthetic-data-plan.md §2). Array POSITION is identity everywhere (position == engine enum value); dead engine slots are explicit {placeholder: true} entries. Entries carrying compiled engine behavior declare a behavior key and must occupy that behavior's fixed slot — the key vocabulary and slot indices live in frontend/modules/jtaSubstrateWrapper/datasetBehaviors.js, and datasetValidator.js is the authoritative enforcement of the cross-reference rules this schema cannot express (unique task ids, slot placement, live-index references).

dataset_id.description: Unique, stable identifier. Save-compatibility key: numeric ids/indices are save-load-bearing, so saves are stamped with and keyed by this id (plan §3.4).

content_hash.description: FNV-1a over the canonical (sorted-key) document minus provenance and dataset_id; dataset_id must end with '-<content_hash>'. An edited document must be restamped (datasetValidator.js --restamp) or validation fails — this is what keeps the (seed, dataset_id) Pass-B cache and the dataset-keyed save slot from being silently poisoned.

theme.description: Dataset-level theme hooks (plan §2.5). v1: namebank-driven title/setting/flavor; narrative fields extend here in later schema versions.

key.description: Optional position-independent zone identity (unique across zones) for topology edges and theme references (post-v1 branching); the engine never reads it.

raw_drain.description: Raw mode only (economy.value_mode 'raw'; validator enforces presence there): the zone's speedup/drain factor, replacing zone_speedup_base^zone at both engine sites (task progress and energy drain per tick).

behavior.description: Behavior key from datasetBehaviors.js PERK_BEHAVIORS; entry must sit at that key's slot index.
Behavior key from datasetBehaviors.js ITEM_BEHAVIORS; entry must sit at that key's slot index.

prestige.description: v1 datasets carry the prestige tables verbatim-vanilla in structure (every unlockable/repeatable slot is behavior-coupled); names/descriptions/theme may vary (plan §2.4).

spark_zone_origin.description: Zone index where divine-spark gain scaling starts (replaces the engine's hardcoded zone 14).

sbtv_unlock_task_ids.description: Task ids revealed by the see_beyond_the_veil unlock (replaces the engine's hardcoded id list). May be empty — v1 synthetic generation creates no unlocker-less tasks.

roles.description: The five skill-identity engine couplings, as data (plan §2.4). Indices into skills[] (live entries only).

economy.description: The global balance backbone, carried explicitly instead of compiled. The formula fields are required in BOTH value modes — under 'raw' they are unused by dataset tasks but remain the fallback formula for runtime-synthesized tasks (host exit tasks, artifact tasks).

value_mode.description: Absent ⇒ 'zone_formula' (vanilla backbone formulas). 'raw' (5g, §7 Q8/Q9 — the DEFAULT for synthetic generation): every task carries raw_cost + raw_xp and every zone raw_drain, all zone-keyed formulas together; the validator enforces completeness.

zone_speedup_base.description: Per-zone speedup/drain backbone (vanilla 1.05), applied to both task progress and energy drain per tick.

item_groups.description: Named item-index groups read by behavior slots (e.g. note_items for the note_item_floor_on_reset prestige unlock).

placeholder.description: Dead slot — keeps array position == engine enum value (REMOVED/DELETED precedent). Also legal at an unused behavior slot.

effect.description: Declarative effect (vocabulary in datasetBehaviors.js EFFECT_KINDS; grows per-behavior as compiled branches migrate to data).

add.description: Added to the skill's speed modifier.

base_amount.description: Energy per unit consumed, before calcItemEnergyGain scaling.

mult.description: All-skill XP multiplier applied while the carrying perk is held (calcSkillXp; ascending perk-index application order).

scope.description: Perk entries only. "prestige" is reserved until the prestige-side XP multipliers migrate (entangled with attunement/spark doubles).

flat.description: Flat variant: added to max energy once when the carrying perk is granted (the tryAddPerk position). Exactly one of flat / per_reset.

per_reset.description: Growth variant: on every energy reset, max energy grows by (current_zone + 1) * per_reset while the carrying perk is held (the calcEnergeticMemoryGain base term).

curve.description: per_reset variant only. "square" is reserved — it is the compiled TranscendantMemory modifier (which squares the total growth gain and auto-grants perk slot 19), not yet migrated.

scope.description: Perk entries only. "prestige" is reserved until the prestige-side starting-energy keys migrate (TranscendantMemory / DivineSupremacy are impure — entangled with other engine branches).

mult.description: Scale variant: task speed AND zone energy drain x mult while the carrying perk is held (the cancellation pair — energy per task unchanged, wall-clock divided), single-tick drain compensated back down, and single-tick tasks complete ALL reps in one tick (declared variant semantics). Exactly one of mult / single_tick_drain_mult.

single_tick_drain_mult.description: Single-tick variant: single-tick tasks drain x this while the carrying perk is held, and zones whose remaining tasks are all free are skipped automatically on energy reset (skipFreeZones — declared variant semantics).

scope.description: Perk entries only. MasteryOfTime stays a compiled prestige behavior (it auto-grants perk slots 7/23 by enum identity and zeroes single-tick drain).

id.description: Dataset-scoped, unique, save-load-bearing (TASK_LOOKUP reviver key). Ids >= 10000 are reserved for runtime synthetic injection.

skills.description: Indices into skills[]. May be empty only for Travel tasks (C1: a skill-less task cannot be paced by the balancer).

cost_multiplier.description: Provisional in Pass-A output; Pass B owns final costs. In raw mode this is the Tier-1 patch lever over raw_cost (generated raw documents fold the profile multiplier into raw_cost and emit 1 here).

xp_mult.description: >= 0: vanilla has deliberate zero-XP tasks. Applies in both value modes (multiplies raw_xp in raw mode).

raw_cost.description: Raw mode only (validator enforces presence there): absolute base cost — the zone/Boss exponential backbone pre-dissolved into the value; cost_multiplier still applies.

raw_xp.description: Raw mode only: absolute per-progress XP base, replacing xp_base × zone backbone; xp_mult still applies.

formula_cost_multiplier.description: Raw mode, INFORMATIONAL (engine-blind): the formula-mode cost multiplier this task would carry if the document weren't raw — the raw fold sets cost_multiplier to 1, which erases this strategy-relevant structure from the data (and post-v1 branching makes it non-reconstructable). Stamped by premultiplyDataset().

formula_xp_mult.description: Raw mode, INFORMATIONAL (engine-blind): the formula-mode xp_mult twin of formula_cost_multiplier. Equals xp_mult in v1 documents (the fold doesn't touch xp_mult) — carried explicitly so the pair is self-contained if the fold policy ever changes.

perk.description: Index into perks[] (live entry) or null. zone_id is NOT in the schema — derived from zone array position.

prestige_layer.description: Required non-null when type is Prestige.
